tools.name: get_app_info
tools.title: About WithU
tools.description: Returns a public overview of the WithU app: what it does, who it's for, main features, and links. Safe for anyone to read.

tools.name: list_membership_plans
tools.title: List WithU membership plans
tools.description: Returns WithU's Care Membership tiers with monthly and yearly pricing in INR and USD, AI-companion quotas, and included features. Public catalog data — safe for anyone to read.

currency.description: Filter to a single currency. Omit to return both.

tools.name: list_crisis_hotlines
tools.title: List crisis and mental health hotlines
tools.description: Returns a curated list of publicly published mental-health crisis hotlines (India and international) with phone numbers and hours. Public safety information — safe for anyone to read.

tools.name: list_grounding_exercises
tools.title: List grounding & calming exercises
tools.description: Returns short grounding and breathing exercises from WithU's public safety library. Optional id filter returns a single exercise.

id.description: Return a single exercise by id.
